graph_from_synapses — CONNGRAPH construct op

• Data kinds: synapse_table → conn_graph

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.graph_from_synapses(syn: 'Any', n: 'int | None' = None, sign: 'float' = 1.0) -> 'np.ndarray' (to call the implementation directly, import conngraph; conngraph.graph_from_synapses(syn: 'Any', n: 'int | None' = None, sign: 'float' = 1.0) -> 'np.ndarray'; from the registry, opsconngraph.get("graph_from_synapses"))

Usage

Turns a synapse table (m, 3) = (pre_id, post_id, count) into an n×n weighted directed adjacency matrix.

W[pre, post] += count * sign. Rows with the same (pre, post) are summed. If n is omitted, max(id) + 1. Ids are 0-based integer values (they may be stored as float); out-of-range, non-integer and negative ids are rejected. sign is a coefficient for when you want to enter inhibitory synapses as negative (count itself is treated as an unsigned quantity).
